lessons: The pygame click flow IS testable headlessly: SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy plus pygame.event.post from a worker thread drives both the main loop and the blocking show_input_dialog / submenu loops in order.
show_input_dialog appends typed characters to initial_text, so a scripted mode change needs an explicit BACKSPACE before the new digit.
Extracting the calibration-first rule into quickmeasure.needs_calibration() turned a GUI-only behaviour into a level-1 assertion; the inline closure version was not directly testable.
